description: Energy ABM models how firms invest in and operate energy assets, with documented electricity-market behaviour for power plants. Its agents represent plants, firms and technologies. Annual simulation steps contain representative market periods, plant bidding and market clearing, firm finance and investment, entry and exit of firms, and cost updates. Inputs include demand patterns, regional capacity factors, technology costs, plant parameters and policy settings. Outputs include plant production and emissions, firm profit and equity, investment decisions, prices, demand, fuel mix and capacity. Coverage depends on the configured regions, technologies and scenario; the inspected overview does not define one geographic case or calibration dataset. Official documentation links to the SESIT GitLab repository, whose language metadata identifies Python. Apache 2.0 is stated in the documentation; charges and deployment requirements are not established here. The project also documents gas and oil model modules, which are not separately assumed validated or added as datasets. No code, model archive, input data or execution results were obtained.
